take: Per the team's announcement, Vancouver placed D Guillaume Brisebois on injured reserve and activated F Filip Chytil from injured reserve. Chytil returns to a VAN team at 3-16-1 that has created 39.9% of the expected goals (a measure of chance quality) this season. In seven games he has two assists and no goals on 1.15 expected goals, averaging 19.89 minutes. Brisebois averaged 15.42 minutes over six games, and the JSON doesn't say who picks up that ice time.
